K-12 Art Teacher

7-12 History

Elementary Teacher

Bainville School is a small K-12 school district located on the Northeastern Border of Montana.  

We are highlighted by having small class sizes, a starting wage of $45,193 with experience up to $63,593. We offer every teacher a $3,000 signing bonus if a contract is signed within 10 days, a $75 per month HSA match, a competitive insurance package as well as available district housing.

Must have a current MT teaching certificate with the correct endorsement in which you are applying. Coaching may also be available.  Job description and application available by calling the District Office at 406-769-2321 or email at dhannum@bainvilleschool.k12.mt.us. Also on our website https://www.bainvilleschool.com.

For a complete application please submit the following:

1. Cover Letter

2. Resume

3. District Certified Application

4. Three Letters of Recommendation

5. Copy of Teaching Certificate

For more information please click on the information below.  For an application please contact us by email or by phone.
